Yes, all of those match what I want — adding tags as pills, removing one with the ×, being offered tags I've used before, still being able to create a brand-new tag, and seeing the saved tags right on the bookmark in the list. That's the whole tagging experience I was hoping for.

The natural next thing I'll want, now that my bookmarks have tags, is to actually put them to use — tapping a tag to see just those bookmarks, and searching through everything. But that's for whenever you're ready; the tag behaviors themselves are all right.
